# 2 Chronicles 12 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 12 (16 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.8
- **EMET:** "For they-shall-be to-him for-servants and-they-shall-know My-service and-service-of kingdoms-of the-lands."
- **LOGOS:** "Nevertheless, they shall be servants to him, that they may know the difference between My service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.""
- **PNEUMA:** "But they will become his subjects, so they will learn the difference between serving Me and serving earthly kingdoms.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.10
- **EMET:** "And-he-made the-king Rehoboam in-their-place shields-of bronze and-he-entrusted on-hand-of chiefs-of the-runners the-keepers-of entrance-of house-of t"
- **LOGOS:** "And King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king's "
- **PNEUMA:** "King Rehoboam replaced them with bronze shields and assigned them to the commanders of the guard who protected the entrance to the royal palace."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.11
- **EMET:** "And-it-was as-often-as came the-king to-house-of YHWH came the-runners and-they-bore-them and-they-returned-them to room-of the-runners."
- **LOGOS:** "And as often as the king went into the house of the LORD, the guard came and carried them and brought them back to the guardroom."
- **PNEUMA:** "Whenever the king went to the LORD's temple, the guards came carrying the shields, then afterward returned them to the guardroom."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.12
- **EMET:** "And-when-he-humbled-himself turned from-him anger-of YHWH and-not to-destroy completely and-also in-Judah were things good."
- **LOGOS:** "And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, so as not to make a complete destruction. Moreover, conditions were good in Judah."
- **PNEUMA:** "Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the LORD's anger turned from him, and He did not destroy him completely. Indeed, there was still some good in Judah."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.14
- **EMET:** "And-he-did the-evil for not he-fixed his-heart to-seek YHWH."
- **LOGOS:** "And he did evil, for he did not set his heart to seek the LORD."
- **PNEUMA:** "He did evil because he never really set his heart on seeking the LORD."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---
